_comment: Anchor to the independent PoC lineages it was observed in.
An anchor is evidence when it recurs across PoCs written independently: two
authors reaching for the same concrete path is a property of the vulnerability,
one author's choice is not. C3 requires an anchor in at least two lineage
components; anything below that is C2 however concrete it looks.
A lineage component groups PoCs related by fork or commit ancestry, by mutual
attribution, or by an identical canonical serialisation of the backward slice.
Computing it needs several PoCs per CVE. This repository carries one PoC per
CVE, so no anchor here reaches two components and the table is empty: every
concrete anchor classifies C2. Populating it requires the multi-PoC corpus,
which is not part of this repository.
